WITH store AS (
    SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date 
    FROM store_sales JOIN date_dim ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
    WHERE date_dim.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1189 + 11 AND store_sales.ss_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk
), catalog AS (
    SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date 
    FROM catalog_sales JOIN date_dim ON catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
    WHERE date_dim.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1189 + 11 AND catalog_sales.cs_bill_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk
), web AS (
    SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date 
    FROM web_sales JOIN date_dim ON web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
    WHERE date_dim.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1189 + 11 AND web_sales.ws_bill_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk
)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
    SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date 
    FROM store INTERSECT ALL 
    SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date 
    FROM catalog INTERSECT ALL 
    SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date 
    FROM web
) t LIMIT 100
